figurative_meaning_en: Pampered and beloved son raised with affection
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বাবার দুলাল, সবসময় তার ইচ্ছামতো চলে।
ঘরের দুলাল হিসেবে সে কখনো কাজ করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is his father's darling, always getting his way.
As the pampered son of the house, he never does any work.
history: Originates from the tradition of swinging babies in cradles (দোলা), symbolizing a cherished child in Bengali households.
note: Often used endearingly for a favorite child, especially sons in traditional families.
